scripts.predev: npm run verify:title-canonical && npm run branch:check && node scripts/assert-no-legacy-b02.mjs
scripts.dev: python scripts/single_branch_guard.py run -- npm.cmd exec -- vite
scripts.prebuild: npm run branch:check && node scripts/assert-title-surface-canonical.mjs && node scripts/assert-title-bgm-canonical.mjs && node scripts/assert-no-legacy-b02.mjs
scripts.build: python scripts/single_branch_guard.py run -- npm.cmd exec -- vite build
scripts.verify:title-canonical: npm run verify:title-surface && npm run verify:title-bgm
scripts.deploy:legal: npm run build:legal && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.preview: python scripts/single_branch_guard.py run -- npm.cmd exec -- vite preview
scripts.browser:reserve: npm run branch:check && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/guard-game-browser-limit.ps1 -Mode reserve
scripts.pretest: npm run branch:check && node scripts/assert-title-surface-canonical.mjs && node scripts/assert-title-bgm-canonical.mjs && node scripts/assert-no-legacy-b02.mjs
scripts.test:watch: python scripts/single_branch_guard.py run -- npm.cmd exec -- vitest
